segments.t: Accept Your Place In The World from Kaltunk

tips.text: Take the quest and run straight to the Den. Kill boars on the way.
Alt note: Legacy's Talented ranks can move your first talent point as early as level 5, but launch spend is capped at 16 and a first character has few points.

sources.label: Icy Veins Legacy: Talented to level 5; launch spend cap 16

professionHooks.note: Herbalism window: from skill 1 pick Peacebloom in Durotar (76 node spawns; densest patch /way Durotar 40.6 33.8), together with Silverleaf (skill 1, 167 spawns). Stay on this loop while questing here until about 50. WoW Forever DB marks this as the Horde pick. Keep the herbs for Alchemy or First Aid potions, or sell them.

sources.label: WoW Forever DB: Herbalism route (Forever node spawns per zone)

professionHooks.note: Herbalism window: from skill 15 pick Earthroot in Durotar (50 node spawns; densest patch /way Durotar 41.0 17.1). Stay on this loop while questing here until about 70. WoW Forever DB marks this as the Horde pick. Keep the herbs for Alchemy or First Aid potions, or sell them.

sources.label: WoW Forever DB: Herbalism route (Forever node spawns per zone)

professionHooks.note: Mining window: from skill 1 pick Copper in Durotar (236 node spawns; densest patch /way Durotar 43.5 53.4). Stay on this loop while questing here until about 65. WoW Forever DB marks this as the Horde pick. Smelt the ore for Blacksmithing or Engineering, or sell bars.

segments.t: Turn in Your Place In The World to Gornek
Accept Cutting Teeth from Gornek

tips.text: Speedrun: pick up every Valley quest before leaving the Den, and do not hand anything in until the boars, apples and weapons are all done.

segments.t: Accept Wayward Weapons from Gornek

sources.label: Hardcore Helper WoW Forever zone guide

tips.text: Forever quest. The Abandoned Training Weapons lie on the ground around the Valley; pick them up while you kill boars.

sources.label: Hardcore Helper WoW Forever zone guide

segments.t: Complete Cutting Teeth

tips.text: Do Cutting Teeth, Wayward Weapons and the cactus apples in the same loop around the Valley.

segments.t: Pick up Abandoned Training Weapons off the valley floor while you kill Mottled Boars.
Turn in Wayward Weapons to Kzan Thornslash

sources.label: Hardcore Helper WoW Forever zone guide

segments.t: Turn in Cutting Teeth to Gornek
Accept Glyphic Parchment from Gornek

tips.text: Forever lets orcs be mages. Gornek gives orc mages this class letter for the mage trainer in the Den, like the other class letters.

segments.t: Accept Tainted Tablet from Gornek

tips.text: Forever lets trolls be warlocks. Troll warlocks get this class letter for Nartok, the warlock trainer in the Den.

segments.t: Turn in Glyphic Parchment to Mai'ah

tips.text: Hand it to the mage trainer in the Den.

segments.t: Turn in Tainted Tablet to Nartok
Troll priests: take In Favor of Spirituality from Ken'jai and talk to Tai'jin in Razor Hill.
Accept Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise from Galgar

tips.text: Cactus Apples grow at the base of the cacti across the Valley. Pick them up between kills.

segments.t: Accept Sting of the Scorpid from Gornek
Accept Vile Familiars from Zureetha Fargaze

tips.text: Warlocks get their own Vile Familiars quest from Ruzan (1485) instead.

segments.t: Accept Vile Familiars from Ruzan

tips.text: Warlocks: Ruzan gives you your own Vile Familiars quest (6 Vile Familiar Heads) instead of the one from Zureetha.

segments.t: Accept Lazy Peons from Foreman Thazz'ril

tips.text: Use the Blackjack on sleeping peons as you pass them; you do not need to go out of your way.

segments.t: Accept Sarkoth from Hana'zua
Complete Sting of the Scorpid

tips.text: Scorpids are north of the Den. Kill them on the way to Hana'za and Sarkoth.

segments.t: Complete Sarkoth

tips.text: Sarkoth is a lone level 4 scorpid in the gully north-west of Hana'zua. Pull him away from the other scorpids.

segments.t: Turn in Sarkoth to Hana'zua
Accept Sarkoth from Hana'zua
Complete Vile Familiars

tips.text: Familiars are north of the Den, in front of the Burning Blade cave. Pull two at a time if your class is strong at level 4 (warrior, hunter).

segments.t: Complete Vile Familiars

tips.text: Same familiars, in front of the Burning Blade cave.

segments.t: Complete Lazy Peons
Loot Cactus Apples from the plants around the valley while you finish the scorpid tails.
Turn in Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise to Galgar

tips.text: Forever change: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise now lets you pick a gathering starter book (Mining for Dummies, Wild Harvest or Pelt Collecting for Beginners) as well as the Cactus Apple Surprise recipe. Pick the one for your planned gathering profession.

sources.label: Hardcore Helper WoW Forever zone guide

segments.t: Turn in Vile Familiars to Zureetha Fargaze
Turn in Vile Familiars to Ruzan
Accept Vile Familiars from Ruzan

tips.text: Ruzan then sends you to Zureetha, who gives you Burning Blade Medallion.

segments.t: Turn in Vile Familiars to Zureetha Fargaze
Accept Burning Blade Medallion from Zureetha Fargaze
Shamans: take Call of Earth from Canaga and loot two Felstalker hooves in the cave.
Turn in Lazy Peons to Foreman Thazz'ril
Accept Thazz'ril's Pick from Foreman Thazz'ril
Grab Thazz'ril's Pick beside the pool in the Burning Blade cave before you kill Yarrog.
Complete Burning Blade Medallion.

tips.text: Yarrog Baneshadow is at the back of the Burning Blade cave. Thazz'ril's Pick lies inside the same cave, so get both in one run.
Pull the cultists in the cave one at a time; they hit hard for level 5.
Stop and drink between pulls in the cave.
Kill Yarrog quickly; he is a caster, so fight him in melee range or interrupt him.

segments.t: Shamans: loot two Felstalker hooves in this cave for Call of Earth.
Turn in Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze
Take the Lost Journal from the barrel beside Zureetha and bring it to Brakk on the way into Razor Hill.
Shamans: hand the Felstalker hooves to Canaga Earthcaller and take the next Call of Earth.
Shamans: drink the Earth Sapta at Spirit Rock, then speak to the Minor Manifestation of Earth.
Shamans: bring the Rough Quartz back to Canaga Earthcaller.
Turn in Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril
Turn in Sarkoth to Gornek
Turn in Sting of the Scorpid to Gornek
Accept Report to Sen'jin Village from Zureetha Fargaze

tips.text: Speedrun: leave the Valley at 5-6 even if not every quest is done; Sen'jin quests give more XP per minute.

segments.t: Visit your class trainer

tips.text: Train level 6 spells at your class trainer in the Valley before you leave.
Forever: each creature can only be skinned once, so skin your own kills right away before someone else does.
Forever: every profession gets a camp object at skill 20. Push your professions to 20 early to unlock it.
Forever: crafting items to sell to vendors no longer pays (vendor prices were cut on 16 Oct). Craft for skill-ups, your own gear and other players.
Forever: healing potions are made with First Aid now, so keep your Linen Cloth for First Aid.
Forever: starter-zone Herbalism and Skinning trainers teach only the first rank. Train the next rank in your capital.

professionHooks.note: Kill Dustwind Harpy (Durotar, lvl 7-8): the recipe Recipe: Minor Spellblasting Potion drops here. Forever-new potion recipe; Dustwind harpies in northern Durotar.
